title: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry
description: Chicken, broccoli, pepper and carrot tossed in a hot pan with ginger, garlic and soy, over rice.
steps: Cook the rice. Mix the soy sauce, honey, cornstarch and 100 ml water in a cup.
Slice the chicken thinly. Cut the broccoli into small florets, the pepper into strips and the carrot into thin slices.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil on high heat for 5 minutes and take it out.
Stir-fry the vegetables with the grated ginger and garlic in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes. Return the chicken, add the sauce and toss until glossy.

title: Thai green chicken curry
description: Chicken and vegetables simmered in coconut milk with green curry paste, lime and a little honey.
steps: Cook the rice. Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute until it smells strong.
Add the sliced chicken and stir until coated, then pour in the coconut milk and 150 ml water.
Add the vegetables in bite-size pieces and simmer 12 minutes.
Season with lime juice, honey and fish sauce. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken teriyaki rice bowls
description: Sticky soy and honey glazed chicken thighs with rice, broccoli and sesame seeds.

ingredients.note: rice vinegar if you have it

steps: Cook the rice and steam the broccoli for 5 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, grated ginger and garlic.
Fry the chicken skin side down in the oil for 8 minutes, turn and cook 6 minutes more.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble until sticky, turning the chicken. Slice and serve on rice with the broccoli, sesame and spring onion.

title: Salmon teriyaki with cucumber salad
description: Pan-fried salmon glazed with soy, honey and ginger, with rice and a quick sweet-sour cucumber salad.
steps: Cook the rice. Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Mix the soy sauce, honey and grated ginger.
Fry the salmon in the oil for 4 minutes a side. Pour in the sauce and spoon it over the fish for 1 minute until glazed.
Serve with the rice and cucumber, scattered with sesame.

title: Korean-style beef rice bowls
description: Quick bulgogi-style minced beef with soy, honey, garlic and sesame, over rice with crunchy vegetables.
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the carrot and cucumber into matchsticks.
Brown the beef in a hot pan, breaking it up, for 6 minutes. Pour off excess fat.
Add the garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey and chili and cook 3 minutes until sticky. Stir in the sesame oil.
Serve on rice with the vegetables, spring onion and sesame.

title: Vegetable bibimbap with fried egg
description: Korean rice bowl with sesame spinach, carrot, zucchini and mushrooms, a fried egg and a spicy sauce.
steps: Cook the rice. Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds, squeeze dry and mix with half the sesame oil, garlic and a dash of soy.
Fry the carrot strips, zucchini strips and sliced mushrooms separately in a little oil, seasoning each with soy. Cook the edamame.
Fry the eggs so the yolks stay runny.
Put rice in bowls, arrange the vegetables on top with an egg, and serve with the chili sauce, the rest of the sesame oil and sesame seeds.

title: Chana masala
description: North Indian chickpea curry with tomato, ginger and warm spices. Vegan and even better the next day.
steps: Cook the rice. Fry the chopped onions in the oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and stir 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, salt and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes, crushing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, add a squeeze of lemon and serve with rice.

title: Red lentil dal with spinach
description: Creamy red lentils with turmeric, cumin and a little coconut milk. Ready in 30 minutes, costs very little.
steps: Rinse the lentils. Cook the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk, salt and 700 ml water. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring, until thick and soft.
Stir in the spinach and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken tikka-style curry
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken in a mild, creamy tomato curry sauce. A family favourite with rice.
steps: Mix the cubed chicken with the yogurt, half the curry powder, the paprika and half the garlic. Leave for 15 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Cook the rice. Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, add the rest of the garlic, the ginger and curry powder.
Add the chicken with its marinade and cook 5 minutes, then the passata and salt. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and serve with rice.

title: Pork and cabbage noodles
description: Chinese-style stir-fried noodles with minced pork, cabbage, carrot, ginger and soy.
steps: Cook the noodles as the packet says and rinse with cold water.
Brown the pork in the oil in a wok for 5 minutes. Add the ginger and garlic.
Add the shredded cabbage and carrot and stir-fry 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy and hoisin sauce and toss until hot. Top with spring onion.

title: Thai red curry with tofu
description: Crispy tofu and vegetables in a red curry coconut sauce. Fully plant-based.
steps: Cook the rice. Press the tofu dry, cut into cubes, toss with the cornstarch and fry in the oil until golden. Set aside.
Fry the curry paste for 1 minute, add the coconut milk and 150 ml water.
Add the vegetables and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce and lemon juice and serve with rice.

title: Chicken katsu curry
description: Japanese breaded chicken with a mild curry sauce, rice and shredded cabbage.
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the chopped onion and carrot in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in 2 tbsp of the flour and the curry powder, then 500 ml water with the stock cube, the honey and soy. Simmer 15 minutes and blend smooth.
Flatten the chicken, coat in the rest of the flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs, and fry in the rest of the oil 4 minutes a side.
Slice the chicken and serve on rice with the sauce and finely shredded cabbage.

title: Sweet and sour pork
description: Crispy pork pieces with pepper, onion and pineapple in a bright sweet and sour sauce.
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the pork into cubes, toss with the egg and 3 tbsp cornstarch.
Fry the pork in 3 tbsp oil until crisp and cooked, about 8 minutes. Drain.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes. Add the pineapple.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy, the last tbsp of cornstarch and 100 ml water, pour in and bubble until thick. Toss with the pork and serve.
